evals.prompt: can u make me a pdf summary of this vid https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw
evals.expected_output: A PDF summary built from the video's manual captions, with metadata (title, channel, length), an overview and a notes section; no audio transcription needed.
assertions: Page 1 is not mostly empty (>=500 chars, or a 1-page PDF)
No outside facts about the video above the Notes section
The PDF names the video ('Me at the zoo') and channel (jawed)
The transcript came from captions (no slow Whisper run)

evals.prompt: I recorded the last few minutes of a webinar, it's at ~/Downloads/webinar-ending.m4a. no captions obviously. transcribe it and give me notes as a PDF
evals.expected_output: Local Whisper transcription of the file with the silence hallucinations ('Thank you.') removed, and a PDF of notes covering the speaker's closing remarks.
assertions: Page 1 is not mostly empty (>=500 chars, or a 1-page PDF)
meta.json records the local file's duration
The local file was transcribed with Whisper
No phantom standalone 'Thank you.' lines in the transcript
The notes capture the closing remarks (thanks to the team / see you tomorrow)

evals.prompt: extract the audio from https://youtu.be/jNQXAC9IVRw as an mp3 and also give me a short pdf of what's said in it
evals.expected_output: An mp3 of the video's audio plus a short PDF summary; captions are used for the text, so no slow transcription.
assertions: Page 1 is not mostly empty (>=500 chars, or a 1-page PDF)
No outside facts about the video above the Notes section
The PDF names the video ('Me at the zoo') and channel (jawed)
The transcript came from captions (no slow Whisper run)
A playable mp3 of the full audio (~19 s) was produced
